Meet the Characters of Walt Disney Animation Studios’ Zootopia ...
Meet the Characters of Walt Disney Animation Studios’
Zootopia 2
November 5, 2025
November 3, 2025
By Courtney Potter
In Walt Disney Animation Studios’
Zootopia 2
, rookie cops Judy Hopps (voiced by Ginnifer Goodwin) and Nick Wilde (voiced by Jason Bateman) find themselves on the twisting trail of a great mystery when pit viper Gary De’Snake (voiced by Academy Award
®
winner Ke Huy Quan) arrives in Zootopia—and turns the animal metropolis upside down!
To crack the case, Judy and Nick must go undercover to unexpected new parts of town, where their growing partnership is tested like never before. Can this unlikely rabbit and fox duo attempt to redeem their reputations, solve Zootopia’s biggest and oldest mystery,
and
prove they really can work together as a team?
With
Zootopia 2
galloping into theaters November 26, we’re taking a look at “zoo’s who”—both returning favorites and new characters…
Judy Hopps (voiced by Goodwin)
Judy has achieved her dream to become Zootopia’s first bunny cop and is determined to prove that she and her partner—former con artist Nick Wilde—can be the best team on the force.
Nick Wilde (voiced by Bateman)
Nick recently became Zootopia’s first fox police officer. But even though he and his partner Judy have cracked the city’s biggest case, Nick finds that he still has a lot to learn about being part of a duo.
Gary De’Snake (voiced by Quan)
Gary is a sweet, lovable—and super venomous—blue pit viper on a mission to restore his family’s good name by solving a Zootopian mystery decades in the making…
Nibbles Maplestick (voiced by Fortune Feimster)
A down-home, oddball beaver, Nibbles has a podcast—
Scales & Tales of the Weird
—that explores conspiracies, reptile mysteries, and rumors about the wetland creatures of her home, Marsh Market.
The Lynxley Family
Milton Lynxley (voiced by David Strathairn) is a powerful business mammal and the patriarch of one of Zootopia’s oldest and most prestigious families. Cattrick (voiced by Macaulay Culkin) is his ambitious, oldest son; Kitty (voiced by Brenda Song) is the sharp-tongued daughter; and Pawbert (voiced by Andy Samberg) is the easy-going runt.
Gazelle (voiced by Shakira)
Zootopia’s biggest pop star, Gazelle is revered by herds (pun intended) of fans.
Mayor Brian Winddancer (voiced by Patrick Warburton)
Mayor Winddancer is an actor-turned-politician—a charismatic but clueless stallion who dreams of being as heroic in real life as the characters he once played on television.
Dr. Fuzzby (voiced by Quinta Brunson)
An adorable quokka (a small Australian marsupial), Dr. Fuzzby is a therapy animal who helps Judy and Nick sort out a few issues in their new partnership.
Flash (voiced by Raymond S. Persi)
He may be a mild-mannered Department of Mammal Vehicles employee, but behind the wheel, Flash has a lead foot and the need for speed!
More Townsfolk
Among the other characters you can expect to meet (or reacquaint with) are
Chief Bogo (voiced by Idris Elba)
, the well-respected head of Zootopia Police Department—who has little patience for Judy and Nick’s shenanigans;
Clawhauser (voiced by Nate Torrence),
Zootopia PD’s charming cheetah receptionist who loves two very important things: pop star Gazelle and donuts; and
Mr. Big (voiced by Maurice LaMarche)
, a tiny arctic shrew who now runs his crime family alongside his favorite daughter
Fru Fru (voiced by Leah Latham)
.
Look for
Zootopia 2
in theaters beginning November 26!
